read.thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA ₹9,938 cr (+106% YoY) driven mainly by LME/market and regulatory tailwinds, with ₹4,372 cr of market-led uplift and net debt cut to ₹3,675 cr; supply additions (Gamsberg Phase II, Debari) are on track but guidance is mostly unchanged.

utilisation.quote: Record 2Q mined metal production of 271 KT, up 5% YoY

capex.quote: Invested Growth Capex of ₹1,135 crore in Q2 FY27, with cumulative H1 FY27 Growth Capex of ₹2,283 crore.

triggers.label: EBITDA +106% YoY, market-driven
triggers.quote: Quarterly EBITDA margin† of 60%, up by 1055 bps YoY and 293 bps QoQ.

triggers.label: Gamsberg Phase II commissioned, VZI 500 kt
triggers.quote: Gamsberg Phase II was commissioned during Q2 FY27, adding 200 ktpa of MIC capacity

triggers.label: Net debt cut ₹4,624 cr QoQ
triggers.quote: Net debt reduced by ₹4,624 crore QoQ to ₹3,675 crore

red_flags.label: Copper International volumes down 74% YoY
red_flags.quote: Copper International sales at 6 kt in Q2, down 74% YoY and 43% QoQ

red_flags.label: EBITDA lift mostly market/regulatory, not volume
red_flags.quote: EBITDA stood at a record ₹9,938 crore in Q2 FY27 and increased 17% QoQ primarily driven by favourable market and regulatory factors

adds.what: Gamsberg Phase II (200 ktpa MIC capacity) at Vedanta Zinc International

growth.why: Record Q2 mined metal of 271 kt (+5% YoY) and FY27 Zinc India mined metal guidance of 1,140-1,160 kt, with Gamsberg Phase II (200 ktpa) commissioned in Q2 FY27 and growth capex of ₹2,283 cr in H1; no explicit revenue growth guidance was given.
